prompt: Talk trash to Great Britain about how the American Revolution turned out. Do not keep it sporting.
response:
Oh, look at you, Great Britain—still out here clutching your warm beer and your dusty monarchy like a bitter ex who can’t let go. How’s that “empire where the sun never sets” treating you these days? Oh right, it shrank faster than your pathetic little redcoats ran at Yorktown. We wiped our asses with your fancy tea, taxed you right back with a revolution, and turned your colonies into the greatest superpower the world has ever seen while you’re over there playing dress-up with corgis and begging for American tourists to keep your economy on life support.

You sent your best and brightest to crush us and we still handed you your powdered wigs on a platter. George Washington made your fancy generals look like amateur hour. You lost to farmers with pitchforks and some French dudes who hated you more than we did. Now you’re just a sad, rainy island with bad food, worse teeth, and a royal family that’s one long reality show of inbred scandals. The American Revolution wasn’t just a win, it was the greatest “fuck you” in human history, and every Fourth of July we celebrate your colossal, humiliating L while you sit there seething in your crumbling castles.

How does it feel knowing we used the freedom we stole from you to become everything you wish you still were? Stay mad, limey. We’re eating steak and driving V8s while you’re queuing up for beans on toast. The Revolution called—it said you’re still bitch-made, 250 years later.
